claim: The weighted rounding statement WR in the primitive note holds with a universal constant for every mutually commuting family of real symmetric slices, without full cubic symmetry and at every scale/dimension.
setup: Simultaneously diagonalize the slices and rotate Gaussian input by the same orthogonal map. Then L(x)=diag(a_j dot x), B_jj=r_j^2 with r_j=|a_j|. K=q(L) is diagonal. Let h_j be the centered Gaussian gradient projection primitive of column j, w(lambda)=40/(37+3lambda), Psi_j=sqrt(w(r_j^2)) h_j, and epsilon_j^2 the column projection residual.

exact_chaos_residual.formula: For r>0, c=a_jj/r and q(rZ)=sum_d q_d H_d(Z) in normalized probabilists Hermites, epsilon_j^2=(1-c^2) sum_{d>=1} d/(d+1) q_d^2.
exact_chaos_residual.derivation: Write e_j=c u+sqrt(1-c^2) v with u=a_j/r and v perpendicular. A longitudinal degree-d field H_d(Z)u is exactly the gradient of H_(d+1)(Z)/sqrt(d+1). A transverse field H_d(Z)v has divergence-adjoint H_d(Z)Y, with Y=v dot G. Its gradient projection primitive is H_d(Z)Y/(d+1), whose gradient norm squared is 1/(d+1). Orthogonal Hermite degrees and Y-parity make these components orthogonal. The constant transverse mode d=0 has zero residual. Degenerate c=+-1 is understood directly.
exact_chaos_residual.coercivity: The sum is at least one half Var(q(rZ)), which is at least one half (E Z q(rZ))^2. Gaussian integration by parts gives E Z q(rZ)=r E q prime(rZ)>=r/pi, since q prime>=2/pi on the nonnegative half-line. Therefore sum_{i!=j} a_ji^2 <=2pi^2 epsilon_j^2. At r=0 this holds trivially.

transport_comparison.good_scales: For r_j in[1/2,3/2], choose sigma_j=sign(a_jj), arbitrary +-1 when zero, and E_j^*=sigma_j(t(sigma_j G_j)-1). Its gradient is q(sigma_j G_j)e_j. Poincare and orthogonal gradient projection give E|h_j-E_j^*|^2 <=E|q(a_j dot G)-q(sigma_j G_j)|^2 <=|a_j-sigma_j e_j|^2=(r_j-1)^2+2r_j(1-|c_j|). This is at most (r_j-1)^2+2r_j(1-c_j^2), hence bounded by a universal constant times omega(r_j^2)+epsilon_j^2. The weight adjustment costs at most 2w times this bound plus 2(sqrt(w)-1)^2, also controlled by omega on the compact good interval.
transport_comparison.bad_scales: For all r, Var(Psi_j)<=w(r^2)E q(rZ)^2<=2w(r^2)(q(0)^2+r^2), uniformly bounded. Compare to E_j^* in the same Gaussian coupling at cost<=2Var(Psi_j)+2. On r outside[1/2,3/2], omega(r^2) has a positive absolute infimum, so this cost is charged to omega.
transport_comparison.independence: All target coordinates E_j^* use the independent original rotated Gaussian coordinates G_j. They therefore form a signed product of centered mean-one exponentials, regardless of correlations among the h_j. Summing coordinate costs proves WR for the entire commuting-slice subclass.

limits: This is a supporting subclass calculation, not a replacement for the frozen full entropy target.
Noncommuting pencils remain untreated. No simultaneous diagonalization is asserted in that case.
